entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
entry.summary:
At 09:07 am, MetService weather radar detected severe thunderstorms near WELLINGTON and WELLINGTON AIRPORT.
These severe thunderstorms are moving towards the eastnortheast, and are expected to lie near WELLINGTON at 09:37 am and near WELLINGTON at 10:07 am.
These thunderstorms are expected to be accompanied by torrential rain.
Impact:
Torrential rain can cause surface and/or flash flooding about streams, gullies and urban areas, and make driving conditions extremely hazardous.
